# SYNESIS_E059 — Error

## Description

Duplicate value `value` in the VALUES block of `field_name`.

## Severity

An **error** stops compilation: no JSON, CSV or other export is written until it is fixed. Errors local to an `EXPORT` block are reported as warnings when compiling and stop only that block in `synesis export`.

## Compiler message

```text
The field 'field_name' has the value `value` declared more than
  once in the `VALUES` block. Duplicate values are ambiguous and may
  produce inconsistent results in exports.
  Remove the duplicate entry.
```

## Where it appears

Values the diagnostic carries (what the message names):

- **DuplicateValue**: `field_name`, `value`
